definitions.explanation: The four seasons of the year: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. A culturally important concept in Japan, where seasonal awareness permeates daily life, food, art, and customs.

examples.japanese: {四季|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the changes of the four seasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四季|しき}⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}している→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: This garden has beauty in each of the four seasons and captivates visitors throughout the year.

notes:
Seasonal awareness (⟦{季節感|きせつかん}→季節感：20736_kisetsukan⟧) is deeply embedded in Japanese culture, influencing food, greetings, poetry, and art. The phrase {四季|しき}⟦{折々|おりおり}→折々：12809_oriori⟧ means 'each season' or 'throughout the seasons.' Japanese people often take pride in the distinctness of the four seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四季|しき}⟦{折々|おりおり}→折々：12809_oriori⟧: each season, throughout the seasons
- {四季|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり→移り変わり：13760_utsurikawari⟧: the changing of the seasons
- {四季|しき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel the seasons
